name: experience-referential-revalidation
title: Experience Layer: referential re-validation + valid-rate metric
description: Add a read-only temporal-validity instrument to the per-project Experience Layer. Finding-signals are derived from historical findings whose file anchors may no longer exist at HEAD (knowledge drift). This story records each signal's anchor files, adds a pure re-validation leaf that classifies a signal valid/stale against the current HEAD file set, and exposes a re-runnable learning_validate CLI that reports valid-rate and drift-rate. Strictly advisory and read-only: no gate, no finding-lifecycle write, no scoring change, writes nothing.
